description: Defines interfaces and classes for data chunk reading, batching, and dataset management in PyTorch data loading, including ChunkDataReader, BatchDataBuffer, and ChunkDataset with prefetching and shuffling capabilities.

classes.name: ChunkDataReader
classes.description: Interface for reading data chunks, supporting reading, counting, and resetting chunks.

classes.name: BatchDataBuffer
classes.description: Manages a queue of data batches, supporting batch retrieval, addition of chunks, exception handling, and stopping mechanism.

classes.name: ChunkDataset
classes.description: A stateful dataset supporting hierarchical sampling, prefetching, shuffling, and batching of data chunks with multi-threaded preloading.

methods.name: get_batch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of data, waiting if necessary until data is available or dataset is exhausted.

methods.name: add_chunk_data
methods.description: Adds preloaded chunk data to the batch queue, handling batch formation and exceptions.

methods.name: add_chunk_data (exception version)
methods.description: Adds an exception to the batch queue to signal errors during preloading.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the batch buffer to stop processing and loading.

methods.name: preloader
methods.description: Worker thread function to preload data chunks, handle exceptions, and notify the batch buffer.

methods.name: free_workers
methods.description: Joins and terminates preloader worker threads.
